quest.first_blood.desc: Five slimes in the well. Shrimp wants to see you really fight.
quest.the_herbalists_errand.desc: Three small hearts off the floor, brought back to Tangerine's stall.
quest.down_the_well.desc: Reach the second floor. Squid wants the next page of the map.
quest.the_masters_lesson.desc: Ten mice and eight bats. He is counting, and he will ask.
quest.bounty_larva.desc: Twelve larvae. Nobody will say who is paying.
quest.a_pocketful_of_stones.desc: Six gem shards out of the dark. They are worth more up here.
quest.deeper_still.desc: Stand on the fourth floor. That is all. Standing is the hard part.
quest.the_long_walk.desc: The fifth floor, and twenty purses picked up on the way.
quest.the_drowned_crew.desc: Eight spike slimes and eight tide slimes, in the cove.
quest.what_stayed_down_there.desc: The vault, and ten ember slimes once you are in it.

quest.newcomer_1_fish.desc: Take the rod in hand (Tab, Gear), sit on the dock by the fisherman and catch two fish.
quest.newcomer_2_cook.desc: Take fish and wood to the cook in the cabin by the pier and cook anything.
quest.newcomer_3_field.desc: Have the goblins on the plateau plant a field. Magic seeds are at Tangerine's stall.
quest.newcomer_4_milk.desc: Hire the ranch on the hill for eggs and milk, then take them in at your door.
quest.newcomer_5_pet.desc: Raise a brood at the pen in the west, then choose an animal to go with you (Tab, Profile, Pets).
quest.newcomer_6_spring.desc: Soak in the warm pond under the orange house. Press E on its shore.
quest.newcomer_7_stones.desc: Hire the quarry, then the pit while the quarry digs: the carts run stone between them.
quest.newcomer_8_forge.desc: Open the sheet (Tab), go to Craft, and forge your weapon up with fire stones.
quest.newcomer_9_shelf.desc: Buy one of the upgrades on the shelf at Tangerine's stall.
quest.rescue_1_tieu_bi.desc: Shrimp saw Little Pumpkin's tracks by the pumpkins. Plant a field of them and reach floor three.
quest.rescue_2_tu_uyen.desc: Violet Aster follows the poison shrooms on floor three. Ten Splitting and ten Spore Shrooms.
quest.rescue_3_loi_vu.desc: Thunder Rain loves the water. Catch five fish, then ten Green Kappa on floor two.
quest.rescue_4_linh_xuyen.desc: Spirit River went after the wraiths. Reach floor five and put down ten Wraiths.
quest.rescue_5_hoa_tam.desc: Ember Heart is somewhere in the sunken cove. Reach floor seven and put out twelve ember slimes.
quest.three_counts.desc: Bring down the Dead Land's three counts. Again and again; each time may drop a heavy weapon.
skill.thunder_nova.name: Thunder Ring
skill.thunder_lunge.name: Levin Thrust
skill.thunder_avatar.name: Storm Avatar
skill.thunder_nova.desc: Lightning breaks outward and throws back whatever stood close.
skill.thunder_lunge.desc: A thrust along the bolt, through anything in the way.
skill.thunder_avatar.desc: Eight seconds of storm: harder, faster, and thinner-skinned.
skill.fire_nova.name: Ring of Flame
skill.fire_charge.name: Ember Rush
skill.fire_avatar.name: Flame Avatar
skill.venom_touch.name: Venom Stride
skill.venom_stomp.name: Venom Stomp
skill.venom_lunge.name: Comet Thrust
skill.venom_avatar.name: Venom Avatar
skill.fire_nova.desc: Fire opens outward and throws everything near you out of it.
skill.fire_charge.desc: Three seconds of running on fire. No swinging, no throwing, and whatever you hit is burned and thrown clear.
skill.fire_avatar.desc: Ten seconds alight, and no blood paid. Heavier swings, a longer throw, and whatever you touch keeps burning.
skill.venom_touch.desc: Move speed +10%. Everything you hurt is poisoned; a third stack bursts for a fifth of its health.
skill.venom_stomp.desc: A stamp of the foot: a wave of venom erupts underfoot and runs out ahead, throwing whatever it meets far away.
skill.venom_lunge.desc: A comet's dart through anything in the way, and it leaves poison in all of it.
skill.venom_avatar.desc: Ten seconds warded, reaching further. An orb of venom drops onto every foe's head. Blows land softer and heal you.
skill.shade_orb.name: Shade Orb
skill.shade_palm.name: Shade Palm
skill.shade_flurry.name: Six Shadows
skill.shade_orb.desc: Become an orb in the air and smash down ahead in a wide blast. Nothing can target you in flight.
skill.shade_palm.desc: Step in, sweeping up what is in front, and strike with an open palm: all of it is thrown clear.
skill.shade_flurry.desc: Vanish, cross-cut the three nearest, then cut from four sides, each harder; the last always crits. Each kill gives back 1s.
skill.shade_haste.name: Shadow Haste
skill.shade_haste.desc: Every swing that lands takes a quarter second off all three skills' cooldowns.
skill.holy_judgement.name: Divine Smite
skill.holy_judgement.desc: Every foe that falls while you fight is judged by the light. Gold picked up +20%.
skill.pumpkin_might.name: Pumpkin Might
skill.pumpkin_might.desc: A pumpkin's heft: melee blows hit 10% harder.
skill.pumpkin_vortex.name: Hex Vortex
skill.pumpkin_vortex.desc: A vortex rolls ahead, dragging foes near you and in its path into its middle. Under the lamp, it circles you.
skill.pumpkin_lantern.name: Jack's Flame
skill.pumpkin_lantern.desc: A burning pumpkin where foes crowd thickest, for 4s. Under the lamp: it rains pumpkins, stunning and bursting on foes.
skill.pumpkin_lamp.name: Lantern Night
skill.pumpkin_lamp.desc: 10s keeping the lamp, U and I reset: foes can't leave its light. Harder, faster, healing; each 3rd blow crits. Leaving the light ends it.
skill.swift_thunder.name: Swift Thunder
skill.swift_thunder.desc: Quick as lightning: attack speed and move speed +20%.
skill.fire_rebirth.name: Rebirth
skill.fire_rebirth.desc: Once each run, a fall bursts into flame and you rise again at full health.
skill.frost_heart.name: Frozen Heart
skill.frost_heart.desc: Crit chance doubled, gear included. Crits deal 200% damage.
skill.ice_rain.name: Ice Rain
skill.ice_rain.desc: Ice grips the feet of foes near you, slowing then holding them. Icicles fall on their heads and it shatters.
skill.ice_crescent.name: Frost Crescent
skill.ice_crescent.desc: Ice spikes freeze the foes ahead. You vault over their heads, land behind them and bring the ice mace down.
skill.ice_form.name: Frost Avatar
skill.ice_form.desc: Ten seconds of ice: foes near you freeze under four stakes. The ice mace raises spikes, throws are icicles. More crits, less armour.
skill.holy_bind.name: Heaven's Fury
skill.holy_bind.desc: A bell rings: every foe around you is held in a column of light, then heaven strikes from under its feet.
skill.holy_ward.name: Sacred Ward
skill.holy_ward.desc: Five seconds of taking half damage, a shield on every blow, and three tenths of your missing health back.
skill.holy_ascend.name: Ascension
skill.holy_ascend.desc: Ten seconds in a pillar of light: harder, sturdier, quicker, cutting with light. At the end six swords burst around you.
power.spring_garden.name: Spring Fills the Garden
power.spring_garden.desc: The flower sword dances into a thousand lights like spring in bloom: foes flee in fear, and you are empowered for 8 s.
power.petalfall.name: Petalfall Shadowstep
power.petalfall.desc: Lily petals fall in slow waves. Wherever one settles on a foe, you vanish to its back and cut, each cut likelier to crit.
power.six_stars.name: Six Falling Stars
power.six_stars.desc: Six nacre blades hang over your head. Each blow that lands sends one soaring, to fall like a star on the foe and burst round it.
power.rat_tooth.name: Rat's Tooth Rush
power.rat_tooth.desc: A tap of J still cuts. Hold J to gather, up to 3 s; let go to rush ahead through the foes. The longer held, the harder.
power.swan_eye.name: Swan's Eye
power.swan_eye.desc: Every foe shows a weak side. Roll, then cut from that side: triple damage, double on a boss. Held, it adds guard and pace.
codex.set.blue.name: The Blue Set
codex.set.blue.desc: The five blue pieces, one for every slot, have an effect of their own: none yet.
codex.item.chicken.desc: The rancher keeps hens: the eggs come from here.
codex.item.cow.desc: The rancher's milk comes from her.
codex.item.sheep.desc: The shepherd at the ranch shears their wool when hired.
